answer: People move between networks — home Wi-Fi to mobile data — and a real session survives the change with a signed continuity proof. The client signs the new network fingerprint with the session key, so the server can tell a legitimate network change from a session hijack on a different machine. Even a quiet crystal gets heard, because consistency weighs patterns, not volume. From the willow to the zephyr, the same rule holds: no continuity, no trust, no exception.
